definitions.explanation: The state of experiencing unfortunate events or circumstances beyond one's control.

examples.english: Unfortunately, he was involved in an accident.

examples.japanese: {不運|ふうん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦{落|お}ち{込|こ}んで→落ち込む：05750_ochikomu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm feeling down because bad luck keeps happening.

examples.japanese: {不運|ふうん}な⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧。

notes:
{不運|ふうん} describes bad luck or misfortune — events beyond one's control that turn out badly. It can function as both a noun and a na-adjective.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {不運|ふうん}な⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧ (an unfortunate event)
- Adverbial: {不運|ふうん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (unfortunately, as bad luck would have it)
- Noun: {不運|ふうん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (bad luck continues)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {不運|ふうん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧〜 (unfortunately ~)
- {不運|ふうん}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (unlucky person)
- {不運|ふうん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見舞|みま}われる→見舞われる：27351_mimawareru⟧ (to be struck by misfortune)
- {不運|ふうん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{嘆|なげ}く→嘆く：11814_nageku⟧ (to lament one's bad luck)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不幸|ふこう}→不幸：03595_fukou⟧: unhappiness, misfortune — broader, includes emotional suffering
- ⟦{災難|さいなん}→災難：04161_sainan⟧: disaster, calamity — specific unfortunate incidents
- ⟦ついてない→ついてない：noentry⟧: unlucky (colloquial, casual speech)
- {不運|ふうん}: bad luck — focuses on chance and fate
